name: protein tyrosine phosphatase 4A1

function.text: PTP4A1 encodes protein tyrosine phosphatase type IVA 1). Annotated molecular activities include protein tyrosine phosphatase activity. It participates in positive regulation of cell migration.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: This gene is included in cancer-panel definitions, but a disease-specific somatic association has not been assigned from the alteration-context sources reviewed for this draft.

function.text: PTP4A1 encodes protein tyrosine phosphatase 4A1. It is a protein tyrosine phosphatase which stimulates progression from G1 into S phase during mitosis. May play a role in the development and maintenance of differentiating epithelial tissues.
